{{Top|leg}}

A '''repulsor pack''' or '''repulsorlift pack''' was a personal conveyance device similar to a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] or [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket pack]]. Repulsor packs were powered by miniaturized [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] generators that operated by pushing the device away from a [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] field, allowing the wearer to fly. Because the packs used repulsorlift technology, repulsor packs could not be operated in a zero-gravity environment. Repulsor packs offered their wearers a slow rate of movement compared to jetpacks or rocket packs, with a top speed of around forty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]. Despite this limitation, repulsor packs were incredibly maneuverable and allowed the user to hover in place by applying a steady thrust. The pack's repulsorlift generators were powered by rechargeable [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cells]] that gave the device around ten [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] of flight time.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
